Yes. The latest assessment detected a **candidate tree-cover loss of 13.5 hectares in 2025**, about 3.9% of the property.

The finding is **pending corroboration**: 2025 is the latest year observed, so a later year is needed to assess whether the change persists. The evidence does not establish the cause, whether deforestation or land-use change occurred, or whether the change was legal.
